faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Junior Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Project Assistant post at IIT Hyderabad is 31st August 2026. Ensure you complete your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BTech degree with a minimum of 60% marks in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Robotics and Automation, Robotics and Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering, or Electronics and Communications Engineering, along with relevant internship or one year of experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Project Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,200 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the IIT Hyderabad Junior Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Junior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their eligibility criteria, academic record, and relevant experience, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Junior Project Assistant position at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of IIT Hyderabad or via the direct application link provided in the important links section before the last date of 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job. The position of Junior Project Assistant is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Project Assistant position as per the official notification.
